About Us

ZVIDAMBANO Traders

Giving value to your harvest. Registered under the Zimbabwean Companies Act.

ZVIDAMBANO Traders (Private) Limited is a Private Limited Company registered under the Zimbabwean Companies Act to carry out agriculture-related business including crop farming, livestock farming, trading of agriculture products, and other agriculture-related business.

The company started operation in 2020 and was officially registered in 2023. We are located and operate in Harare with production units at Ruwa (6 hectares) and Marondera (20 hectares), both supporting irrigation farming.

Our product range spans tomatoes, maize, soya beans, ginger, potatoes, wheat, sunflowers, rice, beans, and livestock products including chicken (eggs, meat, day-old chicks), cattle, goats, and pigs. We also process maize into corn flour and animal feed ingredients, soybean and sunflower by-products into animal feeds.

Through our out-grower management program, contracted farmers produce fertile eggs for hatching, and we manage the storage and transportation of crops produced upcountry into Harare for processing and value addition.

Our Purpose

Mission & Vision

Driven by a commitment to transform agriculture in Zimbabwe and beyond.

Our Mission

Attain all year round sustainable production and supply ability through enhancing small-scale farmers towards the best use of land and giving them a dependable partner that buys and sells their products at a fair price.

Our Vision

Lead the way towards eradicating famine in Zimbabwe and throughout the World by improving the productivity of farmland and the nutritional value of food produced while preserving and enhancing the environment.

Our Core Values

The principles that guide everything we do at ZVIDAMBANO Traders.

Relationships

Agriculture is a people business. We work alongside small farmers — sharing knowledge, resources and growing together through partnership, volunteerism, and mentorship along the value chain.

Service

We serve individuals in the general community by being a reliable, quality-driven partner for farm products — one that both households and small-scale farmers can depend on.

Training & Development

Agriculture is constantly evolving. We promote continual education and training to build talents and develop new skills on the best use of available resources.

Industry Advocacy

We equip our members — majority women — to be advocates of our industry and ensure they receive sustainable income from best farming practice, encouraging more food production.

Environment

The ability to feed the future is vested in the proper conservation of land and environment. Biodiversity conservation measures are part of our agriculture practices.
